I replied to Tobias in his #central-random thread. I confirmed that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats and said I won't change anything else, since he said no action was needed. I also suggested he post the correction in #central-team himself, because that's where the wrong number went up.

I didn't read #central-team or search the knowledge brain, because there was nothing to look up. A seat count is an account fact, not a money term, so there was no finance or approval issue in confirming it.
